---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL HRExt == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems

\* Configuration safety is proved using a local invariant, for all servers:
\* the latest configuration index is accurate, and the committed configuration
\* index is at least the penultimate configuration index.  The sequence and
\* message clauses below supply just the typing needed to preserve that fact.
HRSeq(q) == \E S : q \in Seq(S)
HRLast(A) == IF A = {} THEN 0 ELSE SetMax(A)
HRMsg(m) ==
    /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesRequest =>
          /\ HRSeq(m.mentries)
          /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Int
          /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat)
    /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesResponse => m.mmatchIndex \in Int)

HRLocal(q,c,l,d) ==
    /\ HRSeq(q)
    /\ c \in Nat /\ l \in Nat /\ d \in Nat
    /\ l = LastConfigIndex(q)
    /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= d
HRData ==
    /\ log = [s \in Server |-> log[s]]
    /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ \A s \in Server : HRLocal(log[s], commitIndex[s],
                                latestConfigIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])
HRMessages == \A m \in DOMAIN messages : HRMsg(m)
HRInv == HRData /\ nextIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> Int]] /\ HRMessages

LEMMA HRSeqLength ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q)
  PROVE Len(q) \in Nat
BY LenProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HREmptySequence == HRSeq(<<>>) /\ Len(<<>>) = 0
BY EmptySeq DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRAppendSequence ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e
  PROVE /\ HRSeq(Append(q,e))
        /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,e)[k] = q[k]
        /\ Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1] = e
<1>1. PICK S : q \in Seq(S)
  BY DEF HRSeq
<1>2. q \in Seq(S \cup {e}) /\ e \in S \cup {e}
  BY <1>1, SeqMonotonic
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2, AppendProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRSubSequence ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
  PROVE HRSeq(SubSeq(q,a,b))
<1>1. \A k \in a..b : q[k] \in {q[j] : j \in a..b}
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. SubSeq(q,a,b) \in Seq({q[j] : j \in a..b})
  BY <1>1, SubSeqProperties
<1>3. QED BY <1>2 DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRConcatSequence ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW r, HRSeq(q), HRSeq(r)
  PROVE HRSeq(q \o r)
<1>1. PICK S, T : q \in Seq(S) /\ r \in Seq(T)
  BY DEF HRSeq
<1>2. q \in Seq(S \cup T) /\ r \in Seq(S \cup T)
  BY <1>1, SeqMonotonic
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, ConcatProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRMergeSequence ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW p \in Int, NEW r, HRSeq(q), HRSeq(r)
  PROVE HRSeq(MergeEntries(q,p,r))
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat /\ Len(r) \in Nat
  BY HRSeqLength
<1>2. CASE Len(r) = 0
  BY <1>2 DEF MergeEntries
<1>3. CASE Len(r) # 0
  <2>1. DEFINE Bad(k) ==
          /\ k \in 1..(Len(r)+1)
          /\ \/ k = Len(r)+1
             \/ p+k > Len(q)
             \/ q[p+k].term # r[k].term
  <2>2. Bad(Len(r)+1) /\ Len(r)+1 \in Nat
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF Bad
  <2>21. DEFINE bads == {k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) : Bad(k)}
  <2>22. bads \subseteq Nat /\ bads # {}
    BY <1>1, <2>2, SMTT("r5") DEF bads
  <2>23. HRExt!Min(bads) \in bads /\ \A j \in bads : HRExt!Min(bads) <= j
    BY <2>22, HRExt!MinNat
  <2>3. PICK kk \in Nat : Bad(kk) /\ \A j \in 0..(kk-1) : ~Bad(j)
    <3>1. Bad(HRExt!Min(bads)) /\ HRExt!Min(bads) \in Nat
           /\ \A j \in 0..(HRExt!Min(bads)-1) : ~Bad(j)
      BY <1>1, <2>22, <2>23, SMTT("r5") DEF bads, Bad
    <3>2. QED BY <3>1
  <2>4. \E k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
          /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
               /\ p+j <= Len(q)
               /\ q[p+j].term = r[j].term
          /\ \/ k = Len(r)+1
             \/ p+k > Len(q)
             \/ q[p+k].term # r[k].term
    BY <1>1, <2>3, SMTT("r10") DEF Bad
  <2>5. PICK first : first = CHOOSE k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
          /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
               /\ p+j <= Len(q)
               /\ q[p+j].term = r[j].term
          /\ \/ k = Len(r)+1
             \/ p+k > Len(q)
             \/ q[p+k].term # r[k].term
    OBVIOUS
  <2>6. first \in 1..(Len(r)+1)
    BY <2>4, <2>5, SMTT("r5")
  <2>61. 1 \in Int /\ (p+first-1) \in Int /\ first \in Int /\ Len(r) \in Int
    BY <1>1, <2>6, SMTT("r5")
  <2>7. HRSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1)) /\ HRSeq(SubSeq(r,first,Len(r)))
    BY <2>61, HRSubSequence
  <2>71. HRSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+first-1) \o SubSeq(r,first,Len(r)))
    BY <2>7, HRConcatSequence
  <2>8. QED
    BY <2>5, <2>71, Zenon DEF MergeEntries
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA HRBoundedMaximum ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW A \in SUBSET (1..n)
  PROVE /\ HRLast(A) \in 0..n
        /\ \A k \in A : k <= HRLast(A)
        /\ A # {} => HRLast(A) \in A
<1>1. CASE A = {}
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLast
<1>2. CASE A # {}
  <2>1. A \subseteq Int /\ n \in Int /\ \A y \in A : n >= y
    BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. HRExt!Max(A) \in A /\ \A y \in A : HRExt!Max(A) >= y
    BY <1>2, <2>1, HRExt!MaxIntBounded
  <2>3. HRLast(A) = HRExt!Max(A)
    BY <1>2 DEF HRLast, SetMax, HRExt!Max
  <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA HRConfigBounds ==
  ASSUME NEW q, Len(q) \in Nat
  PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
        /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in 0..LastConfigIndex(q)
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
               k <= PreviousConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. ConfigIndices(q) \subseteq 1..Len(q)
  BY DEF ConfigIndices
<1>2. HRLast(ConfigIndices(q)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
  BY DEF HRLast, LastConfigIndex
<1>3. LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
       /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRBoundedMaximum
<1>4. ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} \subseteq 1..LastConfigIndex(q)
  BY <1>1, <1>3, SMTT("r5")
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4, HRBoundedMaximum, SMTT("r5")
     DEF PreviousConfigIndex, HRLast

LEMMA HRAppendConfigIndices ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e
  PROVE ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) =
          IF e.type = ConfigEntry THEN ConfigIndices(q) \cup {Len(q)+1}
          ELSE ConfigIndices(q)
BY HRAppendSequence, HRSeqLength, SMTT("r10") DEF ConfigIndices

LEMMA HRAppendNonConfig ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e, e.type # ConfigEntry
  PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
        /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = PreviousConfigIndex(q)
BY HRAppendConfigIndices DEF LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex

LEMMA HRAppendConfig ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e, e.type = ConfigEntry
  PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
        /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
       /\ ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) = ConfigIndices(q) \cup {Len(q)+1}
  BY HRSeqLength, HRAppendSequence, HRAppendConfigIndices
<1>2. LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
  BY <1>1, HRConfigBounds, SMTT("r10") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>3. ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) \ {LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e))} = ConfigIndices(q)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r5") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3 DEF PreviousConfigIndex, LastConfigIndex

LEMMA HRMessageTags ==
    /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesRequest
    /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
    /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesRequest
    /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesResponse
    /\ AppendEntriesRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
<1>1. \A a,b : IsFiniteSet({a,b}) /\ Cardinality({a,b}) <= 2
  <2>1. TAKE a,b
  <2>2. {a,b} = {a} \cup {b}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2, FS_Singleton, FS_AddElement, SMTT("r5")
<1>2. \A a,b,c : IsFiniteSet({a,b,c}) /\ Cardinality({a,b,c}) <= 3
  <2>1. TAKE a,b,c
  <2>2. {a,b,c} = {a,b} \cup {c}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2, <1>1, FS_AddElement, FS_CardinalityType, SMTT("r5")
<1>3. ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, NEW c, NEW d,
              Cardinality({a,b,c,d}) = 4
       PROVE a # b /\ a # c /\ a # d /\ b # c /\ b # d /\ c # d
  <2>1. a=b => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. a=c => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. a=d => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>4. b=c => {a,b,c,d} = {a,c,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>5. b=d => {a,b,c,d} = {a,c,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>6. c=d => {a,b,c,d} = {a,b,d}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>61. Cardinality({b,c,d}) <= 3 /\ Cardinality({a,c,d}) <= 3
         /\ Cardinality({a,b,d}) <= 3
    BY <1>2
  <2>7. QED BY <1>3, <2>61, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, MessageDomain

LEMMA HRMessageDomains ==
  ASSUME NEW B, NEW S, NEW m
  PROVE /\ DOMAIN (B (+) SetToBag(S)) = (DOMAIN B) \cup S
        /\ DOMAIN (B (-) SetToBag({m})) \subseteq DOMAIN B
        /\ DOMAIN ((B (-) SetToBag({m})) (+) SetToBag(S))
                 \subseteq (DOMAIN B) \cup S
BY SMTT("r5") DEF (+), (-), SetToBag


LEMMA HRReplaceData ==
  ASSUME HRData, NEW i, NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, NEW d,
         i \in Server => HRLocal(q,c,l,d),
         log' = [log EXCEPT ![i] = q],
         commitIndex' = [commitIndex EXCEPT ![i] = c],
         latestConfigIndex' = [latestConfigIndex EXCEPT ![i] = l],
         committedConfigIndex' = [committedConfigIndex EXCEPT ![i] = d]
  PROVE HRData'
BY SMTT("r10") DEF HRData, HRLocal

LEMMA HRInitial == Init => HRInv
<1>1. HRLocal(<<>>,0,0,0)
  BY HREmptySequence, SMTT("r5")
     DEF HRLocal, LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex, ConfigIndices
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r10")
     DEF Init, ProtocolInit, HRInv, HRData, HRMessages, EmptyBag, SetToBag
, HRLocal
LEMMA HRNoDataChange ==
  ASSUME HRInv,
         UNCHANGED <<log, commitIndex, latestConfigIndex, committedConfigIndex, nextIndex>>,
         \A m \in (DOMAIN messages') \ (DOMAIN messages) :
            m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse}
  PROVE HRInv'
BY HRMessageTags, SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, HRData, HRMessages, HRMsg
, HRLocal
LEMMA HRPassiveActions ==
  ASSUME HRInv,
     \/ \E i \in Server :
          \/ Timeout(i) \/ CompletePersistVote(i) \/ CheckLeaderLease(i)
          \/ DiskBlock(i) \/ DiskUnblock(i)
     \/ \E m \in DOMAIN messages :
          \/ HandleRequestVoteRequest(m.mdest,m)
          \/ HandleRequestVoteResponse(m.mdest,m)
          \/ HandleHeartbeatResponse(m.mdest,m)
          \/ DropStaleMessage(m) \/ LoseMessage(m)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. UNCHANGED <<log, commitIndex, latestConfigIndex, committedConfigIndex, nextIndex>>
  BY SMTT("r5")
     DEF Timeout, CompletePersistVote, CheckLeaderLease, DiskBlock, DiskUnblock,
         HandleRequestVoteRequest, HandleRequestVoteResponse, HandleHeartbeatResponse,
         DropStaleMessage, LoseMessage,
         serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars,
         configVars, persistVars
<1>2. \A m \in (DOMAIN messages') \ (DOMAIN messages) :
            m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse}
  BY HRMessageDomains, SMTT("r10")
     DEF Timeout, CompletePersistVote, CheckLeaderLease, DiskBlock, DiskUnblock,
         HandleRequestVoteRequest, HandleRequestVoteResponse, HandleHeartbeatResponse,
         DropStaleMessage, LoseMessage, Send, SendAll, Reply, Discard, (+), (-), SetToBag
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, HRNoDataChange

LEMMA HRBecomeLeader ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, BecomeLeader(i)
  PROVE HRInv'
BY HRSeqLength, SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, BecomeLeader, LastLogIndex,
       logVars, candidateVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages

LEMMA HRClientRequest ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW value, ClientRequest(i,value)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRSeq(log[i])
  BY DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>2. DEFINE entry == [term |-> currentTerm[i], type |-> ValueEntry,
                      config |-> {}, value |-> value]
<1>3. HRLocal(Append(log[i],entry), commitIndex[i],
                  latestConfigIndex[i], committedConfigIndex[i])
  BY <1>1, HRAppendSequence, HRAppendNonConfig, EntryDomain, SMTT("r5")
     DEF entry, HRLocal, HRInv, HRData, HRMessages
<1>4. HRData'
  BY <1>3, HRReplaceData, SMTT("r10")
     DEF ClientRequest, entry, HRInv, HRData, logVars, serverVars,
         leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, ClientRequest, leaderVars, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages

LEMMA HRProposeConfig ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW s, ProposeConfigChange(i,s)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRSeq(log[i]) /\ Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRSeqLength DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>2. DEFINE entry == [term |-> currentTerm[i], type |-> ConfigEntry,
               config |-> IF s \in latestConfig[i] THEN latestConfig[i] \ {s}
                          ELSE latestConfig[i] \cup {s}, value |-> Nil]
<1>3. HRLocal(Append(log[i],entry), commitIndex[i],
                  Len(log[i])+1, committedConfigIndex[i])
  BY <1>1, HRAppendSequence, HRAppendConfig, SMTT("r5")
     DEF entry, HRLocal, HRInv, HRData, ProposeConfigChange, HRMessages
<1>4. HRData'
  BY <1>1, <1>3, HRReplaceData, HRAppendSequence, SMTT("r10")
     DEF ProposeConfigChange, entry, HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, ProposeConfigChange, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages

LEMMA HRReplicateEntries ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, ReplicateEntries(i,j)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. Len(log[i]) \in Nat /\ nextIndex[i][j] \in Int /\ commitIndex[i] \in Nat
  BY HRSeqLength, SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>2. HRSeq(IF nextIndex[i][j] > Len(log[i]) THEN <<>>
           ELSE SubSeq(log[i],nextIndex[i][j],Len(log[i])))
  BY <1>1, HREmptySequence, HRSubSequence, SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRMessageDomains, HRMessageTags, SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HRMsg, ReplicateEntries, Send, LastLogIndex,
         serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars,
         configVars, persistVars, HRData, HRLocal, (+), SetToBag

LEMMA HRSendHeartbeat ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, SendHeartbeat(i,j)
  PROVE HRInv'
BY HREmptySequence, HRMessageDomains, HRMessageTags, SMTT("r10")
   DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HRMsg, SendHeartbeat, Send,
       serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars,
       configVars, persistVars, HRData, HRLocal, (+), SetToBag

LEMMA HRReceiveAppend ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleAppendEntriesRequest(m.mdest,m)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. DEFINE i == m.mdest
            q == MergeEntries(log[i],m.mprevLogIndex,m.mentries)
            lc == LastConfigIndex(q)
            pc == PreviousConfigIndex(q)
            c == IF m.mcommitIndex > commitIndex[i]
                 THEN Min(m.mcommitIndex,Len(q)) ELSE commitIndex[i]
            d == IF lc <= c THEN lc
                 ELSE Max(pc,Min(committedConfigIndex[i],lc))
<1>2. HRSeq(m.mentries) /\ Len(m.mentries) \in Nat
       /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Int /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat
  BY HRSeqLength DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HRMsg, HandleAppendEntriesRequest, HRData, HRLocal
<1>3. i \in Server => HRLocal(q,c,lc,d)
  BY <1>2, HRMergeSequence, HRSeqLength, HRConfigBounds, SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, i, q, lc, pc, c, d, Min, Max, HRMessages
<1>4. HRData'
  BY <1>3, HRReplaceData, SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRInv, HRData, HandleAppendEntriesRequest, i, q, lc, pc, c, d,
         serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars,
         configVars, persistVars, HRLocal, HRMessages
<1>5. HRMessages'
  BY <1>2, HRMessageTags, HRMessageDomains, HRSeqLength, SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HRMsg, HandleAppendEntriesRequest, Reply, HRData, HRLocal
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, SMTT("r5")
     DEF HRInv, HandleAppendEntriesRequest, leaderVars, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages

LEMMA HRReceiveReplicate ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleReplicateResponse(m.mdest,m)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRData'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HandleReplicateResponse,
      logVars, configVars
<1>2. m.mmatchIndex \in Int
  BY DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HRMsg, HandleReplicateResponse
<1>3. nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Int]]
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r10") DEF HRInv, HandleReplicateResponse, Max, leaderVars
<1>4. HRMessages'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, HRMessages, HandleReplicateResponse, Discard,
                         (-), SetToBag
<1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>4 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRAdvanceCommit ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, AdvanceCommitIndex(i)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. DEFINE indices == {idx \in (commitIndex[i]+1)..Len(log[i]) :
             /\ IsQuorum(({i} \cup {s \in Server : matchIndex[i][s] >= idx})
                             \cap latestConfig[i],latestConfig[i])
             /\ log[i][idx].term = currentTerm[i]}
<1>2. Len(log[i]) \in Nat /\ commitIndex[i] \in Nat
       /\ indices # {} /\ indices \subseteq 1..Len(log[i])
  BY HRSeqLength, SMTT("r5")
     DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, indices, HRMessages
<1>3. SetMax(indices) \in Nat
  BY <1>2, HRBoundedMaximum, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLast
<1>4. HRData'
  BY <1>3, HRConfigBounds, HRSeqLength, SMTT("r10")
     DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, AdvanceCommitIndex, indices, LastLogIndex,
         configVars, logVars, HRMessages
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, AdvanceCommitIndex, leaderVars, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages

LEMMA HRCrash ==
  ASSUME HRInv, NEW i \in Server, Crash(i)
  PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRSeq(log[i]) /\ Len(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY HRSeqLength DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal
<1>2. LastConfigIndex(log[i]) \in Nat /\ PreviousConfigIndex(log[i]) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, HRConfigBounds, SMTT("r5")
<1>3. HRData'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r10") DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, Crash
<1>4. nextIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Int]] /\ HRMessages'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, HRMessages, Crash
<1>5. QED BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRInductive == HRInv /\ [Next]_vars => HRInv'
<1>1. HRInv /\ ProtocolNext => HRInv'
  BY HRPassiveActions, HRBecomeLeader, HRClientRequest, HRProposeConfig,
     HRReplicateEntries, HRSendHeartbeat, HRReceiveAppend, HRReceiveReplicate,
     HRAdvanceCommit, HRCrash DEF ProtocolNext
<1>2. HRInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => HRInv'
  BY DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages, HRMsg, vars, protocolVars,
         historyVars, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars,
         diskVars, configVars, persistVars
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF Next

LEMMA HRConfigurationConsequence == HRInv => ConfigurationSafety
<1>1. ASSUME HRInv, NEW s \in Server
       PROVE Cardinality({k \in (Max(commitIndex[s],committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
                          log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry}) <= 1
  <2>1. DEFINE indices == {k \in (Max(commitIndex[s],committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
                          log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry}
  <2>2. Len(log[s]) \in Nat /\ commitIndex[s] \in Nat
         /\ committedConfigIndex[s] \in Nat
         /\ PreviousConfigIndex(log[s]) <= committedConfigIndex[s]
    BY <1>1, HRSeqLength DEF HRInv, HRData, HRLocal, HRMessages
  <2>3. indices \subseteq {LastConfigIndex(log[s])}
    BY <2>2, HRConfigBounds, SMTT("r10") DEF indices, ConfigIndices, Max
  <2>4. QED BY <2>3, FS_Singleton, FS_Subset, SMTT("r5") DEF indices
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF ConfigurationSafety

LEMMA HRInvariant == Spec => []HRInv
<1>1. Init => HRInv BY HRInitial
<1>2. HRInv /\ [Next]_vars => HRInv' BY HRInductive
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF Spec
